<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation['nodes']
    R=wall=None
    for n in s:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; R=(min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
        if n['color']=='p':
            b=n['boundary']; wall=(min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels'])
    return R,wall
print("start:", snap(current_frame))
# Probe 1: click left socket ring top edge
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':32,'col':13}], intent='explore')
print("after click socket ring:", snap(current_frame), last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
# Probe 2: activate L (in socket) then press RIGHT toward wall
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':13},{'action':'RIGHT'}], intent='solve')
print("after L-active+RIGHT:", snap(current_frame), last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
